note: After the revision by Constantino (1995); the original is in English. The soldier and the large worker are described; soldier measurements (1 individual): head length 7.30 mm, maximum head width 6.30 mm, head height without postmentum 3.90 mm, frontal tube length 0.32 mm, left mandible length 2.80 mm, curvature 1.05 mm, M1—M2 distance 0.76 mm, left mandible width 0.96 mm, left mandible M1 length 0.24 mm. Known only from the type series, from a single colony in Guyana. OCR noise has been interpreted from the context.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head elongate with parallel sides, mandibles very short and stout, thoracic spines weak, head and thorax largely hairless; the most similar soldiers are S. barbatus (hairs dense, mandibles strongly hooked) and S. crassilabrum (mandibles longer, labrum large and fleshy, head with more hairs).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Posterior margin of the head rounded or weakly trilobate; frontal tube prominent, the pore not visible in dorsal view; labrum short, length and width subequal, lateral angles almost right-angled, midlobe short. Antennae 19-segmented. Postmentum not constricted, the sides of the posterior part nearly parallel. Mandibles short and stout, strongly inflated at the base, slightly hooked apically; both mandibles with a well-developed first marginal tooth near the middle, the angle between the tooth and the apical cutting edge obtuse, the apical cutting edges of both mandibles evenly curved. Anterior margin of the pronotum distinctly concave, posterior margin nearly straight; lateral processes of the thoracic nota horizontal; thoracic spines weak; lateral angles of the pronotum acute but not forming conical spines. Dorsum of the head capsule with only about 8 short setae in the clypeal region, the mandibular bases hairless; anterior corners of the postmentum with 2 erect setae and a few scattered hairs; pronotum with only a few setae. Postmentum only slightly constricted posteriorly.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Large worker: postclypeus with 4 setae; fontanelle circular and small; antennae 20-segmented; spines of the thoracic nota moderately developed; mandibular molar plate very narrow. Hind gut not dissected; the available material is poorly preserved.
